verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents adding SAFEs directly to the cap table (eqvista-docs-10) and has built-in e-signing for equity agreements in general (eqvista-docs-11). A support article covers converting notes by the price-per-share method, though in a spreadsheet context (eqvista-docs-18), and round modeling shows dilution from new investments (eqvista-docs-19, eqvista-docs-20). Nothing confirms that SAFE or note documents can be generated, sent, and e-signed in-platform end to end, and conversion modeling of caps and discounts is only implied. Missing for 10: evidence of in-platform SAFE/convertible note document creation and sending, e-signing specifically applied to SAFEs/notes, explicit modeling of conversion terms (cap, discount, MFN) on the cap table, and independent corroboration.
